pages.text: Brew oils and elixirs at a crafting table or alchemy workbench. Oil works from your main inventory for 40 successful hits against the right category. Elixirs last 180 seconds. Matching oil and elixir can work together.
Individual oil and elixir entries show their live recipes. For forest essence, collect a brown mushroom, a fern and a poppy. Hunting a Leshen is optional.
